# Guidelines for management of neurologic toxicity, including ICANS

# (Immune Effector Cell-Associated Neurotoxicity Syndrome)

# Immune Effector Cell-Associated Encephalopathy (ICE) Score

[Click here Calculate ICE Score](orzid2-gmenu-ice-assessment-for-icans)

# ICANS GRADE & DEFINING SYMPTOMS

# MANAGEMENT

# Grade 1

-ICE score 7-9 with no depressed level of consciousness

-Supportive care

# Grade 2

-ICE score 3-6 and/or

-Supportive care

-Mild somnolence awaking to voice

[Click here to order Dexamethasone 10mg IV ONCE STAT](psjzid-dexamethasone-10mg-iv-once-stat)

[Click here to order Dexamethasone 10mg IV q12h](psjzid-dexamethasone-10mg-ivp-q12h)

-Monitor neurologic symptoms and consider consultation with neurologist

and other specialists for further evaluation and management.

# Grade 3

-ICE score 0-2 and/or

-Recommend intensive monitoring ICU

-Depressed level of consciousness awakening only to tactile stimulus and/or

-Consider mechanical ventilation for airway protection

-Any clinical seizure focal or generalized that resolves rapidly or

[Click here to order Dexamethasone 10mg IV q6h](psjzid-dexamethasone-10mg-iv-q6h-no-stop-date)

-Nonconvulsive seizures on EEG that resolve with intervention and/or

-Consider repeat neuroimaging (CT or MRI) q 2-3 days if patient has persistent

-Focal or local edema on neuroimaging

Grade >/=3 neurotoxicity

-Consult neurology for seizure control.

# Grade 4

-ICE score 0 (patient is unarousable and unable to perform ICE) and/or

-ICU care

-Stupor or coma and/or

-Consider mechanical ventilation for airway protection

-Life threatening prolonged seizure (>5minutes) or

[Click here to order High dose Methylpred 500mg IV q12h x3days THEN taper](psjzid-methylpred-high-dose-icans-with-taper)

-Repetitive clinical or electrical seizures without return to baseline

[Taper: 250mg IV q12hx2days, then 125mg IV q12hx2days, then 60mg IV q12hx2days]

in between and/or

-Consider repeat neuroimaging (CT or MRI) every 2-3 days if patient has

-Diffuse cerebral edema on neuroimaging, decerebrate or decorticate posturing

persistent Grade >/=3 neurotoxicity

or papilledema, cranial nerve VI palsy, or Cushing's triad

-Treat convulsive status epilepticus (ICU)
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU BISPECIFIC NEW ICANS MONITORING
